title: Patriotic art gets the spotlight as NEA funding shifts. Cue 'The Ronald Reagan Overture'
summary: Patriotic art and music is taking center stage this year under the Trump Administration, as funds shift away from DEI. For some orgs, like the Reagan Presidential Library, this is their wheelhouse.
